I can’t reliably determine the final values by manually simulating this long sequence. You can have R evaluate it directly: save the assignments in `assignments.txt`, then run:

```r
env <- new.env(parent = baseenv())
text <- readLines("assignments.txt")
text <- text[!grepl("^\\s*//", text)]
eval(parse(text = text), envir = env)

vars <- c("a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h", "TMP")
cat("ANSWER: ",
    paste(sprintf("%s ?= %s", vars, vapply(vars, get, "", envir = env)),
          collapse = "; "),
    ";\n", sep = "")
```

This prints the requested `ANSWER:` line.
